title: Cún đội khăn xếp
lesson: Muốn mượn đồ thì phải hỏi trước.

lines.text: Ơ! Khăn của anh đâu rồi?
Cún đội giống ông nội ghê! Hì hì!
Lần sau muốn mượn thì hỏi anh nhé!

shots.key_pose: Tí stands near the low stool facing camera, smiling, wearing the khăn xếp; Cún sits on the right, tail wagging.
shots.action: Tí takes off the khăn xếp and gently sets it on the low wooden stool, then turns away to tie his sash; Cún tiptoes like a sneaky cartoon spy, picks up the khăn xếp with its mouth and plops it onto its own head, slightly crooked. Tí turns back, eyes pop wide, mouth a big O.
Cún trots proudly in a big circle on the flat yard wearing the khăn xếp; bareheaded Tí jogs slowly after it on flat ground, laughing, arms out; leaves swirl. Camera pans gently with them.

Cún stops and sits with the khăn xếp crooked on its head, making a funny proud face; bareheaded Tí kneels beside it, giggles and says the first line, then gently straightens the hat on Cún's head and says the second line with a kind smile, wagging a finger softly. Slow push-in.
